field_descriptions.alignment_type: A category of alignment between the learning resource and the framework node. Recommended values include: 'requires', 'textComplexity', 'readingLevel', and 'educationalSubject'.
field_descriptions.educational_framework: The framework to which the resource being described is aligned.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.target_description: The description of a node in an established educational framework.
field_descriptions.target_name: The name of a node in an established educational framework.
field_descriptions.target_url: The URL of a node in an established educational framework.
